title: Why VR is finally ready to replace your monitor

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Do you ever wish you could step into your work?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: VR headsets now beat monitors in both price and performance.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s a standalone device with a 4K resolution and 120Hz refresh rate.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The latest models use inside-out tracking and don’t need external sensors.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Gaming, design, and remote work are all better in immersive 3D space.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This tech is changing how we interact with digital worlds every day.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Have you tried using VR for something other than gaming?

caption_text: Why VR is finally ready to replace your monitor
